name: hugeat_tail
desc: The huge pink paint shark lunges forward and slams its jaws shut down over the muscular crocodile and the small cat it is hugging, engulfing them completely from above so that nothing of them is left outside the mouth, goo squeezing out between the teeth, then a big gulp and the shark cheeks and belly bulge with the shape of the two inside. Gooey, viscous.
